# P36.60 — Evidence hub and artifact pages (K8 EV-02)

Manifest row 403. Branch `r11/P36.60-evidence-hub-and-artifact-pages`, stacked on `r11/P36.59-watch-pages-and-item-pages` (the operator retargets to `main`). `live_verification=false` — no `live:`-leg, no production mutation, no gate flips.

## What landed

The evidence surfaces become a traversable T1, zero-JS route family over `web/evidence.json` (`sig.evidence-artifact/1`):

| route | content |
|---|---|
| `/evidence/` + `/evidence/page/<n>/` | the §4.1 hub: "what evidence means" intro, the current-state banner, the state-of-the-evidence roll-up (artifacts, run records, captures, captures with stored bytes, claim views), the browse-artifacts list ≤50 rows (K9 §6.1), the facet nav, the claim-views index, the JSON twin |
| `/evidence/source/<id>/`, `/evidence/type/<genre>/`, `/evidence/lane/<lane>/`, `/evidence/state/<binding_state>/`, `/evidence/place/<path>/` (+ `…/page/<n>/`) | the five one-dimension facet lists (J3 G-11); `place` carries the honest `unplaced` bucket |
| `/evidence/artifact/<E-handle>/` + `.json` | the §4.2 artifact page: human title (a UUID-shaped recorded title composes `<source> — <type> (run <date>)`, never a bare id), source, type, place, classification, lane + basis, upstream (the S-6 publication form), the capture-history table, claims supported, contradictions, status, rights, used-by (watch items + open tasks), equivalent requests, cite |
| `/evidence/artifact/<E-handle>/diff/<capA>..<capB>/` | the §4.4 field-by-field capture diff — minted only where BOTH captures of the same artifact carry extracted fields (SIG-EVUI-005) |
| `/evidence/claim/<id>/` + `.json` | the claim viewer at its canonical address (moved from `/evidence/<id>/` per K13 §2.5); the JSON twin strips `document_text` where the pane forbids bytes |
| `/evidence/<id>/` | the retired claim address: a noindex moved stub (0s meta refresh + link) + the JUR-05 generator's `301 → /evidence/claim/<id>/` rule — one exact rule per published claim id, through the single redirect generator |
| `/evidence/index.json` | the hub's `sig.evidence-index/1` twin |

Honesty carried through: a `synthetic` capture renders the verbatim `run record — SIG did not store this document` label and never a stored-document implication (D-K8-4 [B-44] — the plan cell, carried verbatim); `view_original` renders only the export's minted label/href — no fabricated download; the eligibility gate is structural (withheld/withdrawn artifacts mint no page and list on no index, SIG-EVUI-006); `E-<place>-<code>-<slug>-<hash>` handles follow K11 §3 with a deterministic collision pass; every absent field is a named absence.

Links in: `/sources/<id>/` gains "evidence artifacts →" where the registry id has emitted artifacts; the watch item page links claims to `/evidence/claim/<id>/` and artifact ids to artifact pages through the one handle map; the artifact page links back to its source page only when emitted.

Owns SIG-EVUI-001/002/003/005/006/008; consumes SIG-EVUI-010's handle requirement within a release (the producer-side `evidence_handles_history.json` map is a later row — `getHandleHistories()` already reads it when emitted). Cites SIG-UI-039/040, SIG-ENG-042.
